title: Tasks OpenAPI schema changes require regenerating frontend and MCP client files
answers: Which generated files must be updated when modifying tasks API views?
What needs to be regenerated after changing OpenAPI documentation in products/tasks/backend/presentation/views/api.py?
Why are frontend or MCP task clients out of date after changing backend tasks endpoints?
body:
When updating OpenAPI descriptions, serializers, or endpoints in products/tasks/backend/presentation/views/api.py, the generated frontend and MCP API client code must be regenerated together:
- Frontend API client: products/tasks/frontend/generated/api.ts
- Frontend Zod schemas: products/tasks/frontend/generated/api.zod.ts
- MCP Tasks API client: services/mcp/src/generated/tasks/api.ts
Do not edit these generated files manually; regenerate them so that route definitions and schema descriptions stay synchronized across backend, frontend, and MCP services.
applies: Tasks backend API endpoints and generated frontend/MCP clients
says: Task management interface does not show newly added backend fields and options
AI assistant cannot access updated options when launching background workspace tasks
The task configuration modal displays outdated parameters after recent backend updates
Automated task client fails because form fields do not match server options
